_doc: Commands run inside the sandbox right after every sandbox/setup.py call (after swegemma's wheel injection), by harness/common/envfix.py. 'repos' keys are repo short names ('*' = every repo); 'tasks' keys are instance ids. Override wheels live in /opt/gemma4/wheels (baked into the image). Rationale per entry: docs/grader.md.

*.reason: 1) unshadow: injected wheel copies of the repo's own package shadow the workspace for src-layout repos (requests, httpx). 2) resolve: swegemma injects the newest version of every wheel; swap in the highest /wheels version satisfying the snapshot's own Requires-Dist + requirements*.txt (e.g. fastapi needs starlette<0.49, not 1.6.0).

requests.reason: httpbin under Werkzeug 3.x normalizes malformed redirect Locations differently (test_redirecting_to_bad_url[http://localhost:-1-InvalidURL] DID NOT RAISE). /wheels ships werkzeug 2.3.8 + flask 2.3.3 (inferred: for exactly this); pin them. Verified on requests_6589/6592/6629.
